discovery: Optical detection and coherent control of single electron spins in solid-state colour centres, establishing quantum sensing and spin-photon interfaces in diamond
motivation: The nominees showed that a single electron spin, trapped in an atomic-scale defect in diamond, can be found, read out optically and coherently controlled at room temperature. Wrachtrup pioneered optically detected magnetic resonance of single nitrogen-vacancy centres and their coherent manipulation. Awschalom showed nanosecond coherent control and coherent coupling of single defect spins to their environment, and broadened the field to new host materials. Lukin introduced nanoscale magnetometry with single spins and the use of nuclear-spin memories, and built entanglement between spins and photons. Together, this work turned a crystal defect into a quantum laboratory. It created quantum sensing that can image magnetic fields of single molecules, neurons and condensed-matter phases. It also opened solid-state quantum network nodes. Few platforms have united fundamental quantum control with such broad scientific and practical reach.
